messages:
Alex (Sales): Quick heads-up — Acme wants a hosted POC next Wed. They plan a live demo and asked for a temporary burst/raised quota for one session (~90m). They want a scoped API key and IP allowlist. Can we do 200 qps for the demo window?
Priya (SE): Do we have their traffic profile? tokens per second or avg tokens per request? Also need region and whether they use streaming.
Alex (Sales): I asked them — expected ~5 concurrent clients, ~3 requests/sec each, avg 800 tokens/request, max_tokens 1024, streaming on. Region: us-west.
Samir (Infra): 200 qps is roughly 160k tokens/minute at that avg — that’s nontrivial on hosted. We can do a short-lived override if we confirm safety controls: scoped key with expiry, IP allowlist, and a sandbox org.
Mike (Support): We should also warn about costs — at that token volume the POC could rack up charges. We can attach a spend cap on the key and metering alerts.
Priya (SE): Mitigations to reduce footprint: reduce max_tokens to 512 for demo, use streaming to surface partial results, enable prefix KV cache if they have repeated prompts. Also can multiplex requests from clients to avoid spikes.
Alex (Sales): They want 1024 to show long-context behavior. Can we do a short burst at 200 qps for 90m with a strict expiry?
Samir (Infra): Yes, but will need an infra ticket and an ops approval. Please provide exact key name, expiry timestamp, allowed IPs, org id, and expected token budget. Also indicate if fallback to lower-QPS model variant is acceptable.
Alex (Sales): Key name: acme-demo-2026-03-31. Expiry: 2026-03-31T22:30Z (90m window). IPs: 34.120.0.0/24, 34.121.0.0/24. Org id: org_8765. Token budget: 15M tokens. Fallback: yes, to smaller model if needed.
Samir (Infra): OK filing request. Need explicit confirmation on spend cap and audit logging. Can you also confirm they accept role-based access and that we enable request tracing?
Alex (Sales): Confirmed — spend cap $1,200; auditing/logging and trace IDs are fine. They want SSO for the console later but not required for demo.
Mike (Support): I'll prepare a short doc for them on best-effort cost controls and how to limit max_tokens on the client.
Priya (SE): For the record, if performance matters we recommend: 1) enable batching at client if possible, 2) shorter context for demo paths, 3) pre-warm KV cache with sample prefixes. This can cut cost 2-3x.
Samir (Infra): Filed INFRA-4587 with details. Requesting temporary rate-limit override to 200 qps for key acme-demo-2026-03-31, expire 2026-03-31T22:30Z, token budget 15M, IP allowlist applied, spend cap $1,200. Pending ops approval.
deploy-bot: INFRA-4587 created by samir_infra — status: pending_review.
Priya (SE): If ops approves, ops will also attach a soft throttle that auto-falls back to 50 qps if error rate > 5% or GPU pressure exceeds threshold. Prefer that to prevent impact on other customers.
Samir (Infra): Agreed. I'll request automatic fallback policy in the ticket.
Alex (Sales): Thanks — please ping me when approved, need to share credentials with Acme two business days before the demo. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: INFRA-4587 status changed to approved by ops_lead. Temporary override scheduled 2026-03-31T21:00Z to 2026-03-31T22:30Z. Key acme-demo-2026-03-31 scoped, ip_allowlist applied, spend_cap set.
Mike (Support): I'll assemble the short how-to and cost-safety doc and send to Alex.
Alex (Sales): Perfect — sharing with Acme now. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Priya (SE): Post-demo follow-up: we'll capture perf metrics and recommend Dedicated pool if they want sustained throughput.
Samir (Infra): Noted. Closing loop after demo and INFRA-4587 will contain logs/traces for postmortem.
Alex (Sales): Closing the thread — thanks everyone.
